timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Six Zero Trust pillars. I've got that. So we're done, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Almost. There's a seventh nobody talks about: visibility, automation, and orchestration.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: A seventh pillar? What does it do?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Every pillar generates alerts. This pillar makes sense of all that noise.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: More than that. It integrates signals, automates response, and coordinates controls across tools.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Why can't each pillar just monitor itself?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Because an attack spans pillars. Risky sign-in here, strange device there — only correlation connects them.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Response at machine speed. Policy enforcement, detection, and remediation without waiting for a human.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. One signal drives a control in another pillar. Anomaly in identity triggers device isolation.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So the seventh pillar is the nervous system.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Without it, the other six are just expensive sensors.
